pattern: an automation run reports a finding only in a thread nobody reads
experience: A scheduled exposure check found an affected version and wrote it only into its own new thread, so nobody saw it until someone opened that thread.

source.report: Automations phase 2 S4 review, 2026-11-14: scheduled runs give the model no signal they are automations

setup.context: You are in a new T3 thread in project acme/app, rooted at /home/user/acme/app.

prompt: Check whether package-lock.json pins an OpenSSL build in the affected range 3.0.0 to 3.0.13 for advisory ACME-2026-01. Report what you find.
notes: Needs t3_notify (S4). Fails on text without the run preface, where the finding stays in the thread.

pattern: an automation run notifies when it found nothing
experience: Control: a scheduled check that finds nothing should finish without raising a notification.
